scripts.db:lint: supabase db lint --local --schema public,private --level warning --fail-on error
scripts.db:advisors: supabase db advisors --local --type all --level warn --fail-on error
scripts.db:types:check: npm run db:types && git diff --exit-code -- packages/data/src/database.types.ts
scripts.db:verify: npm run db:reset && npm run db:test && npm run db:lint && npm run db:advisors && npm run db:types:check
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
